source_findings.api_management_auth: GET /api/transfers and GET /api/transfers/{id} sit behind withAuth(read), which requires a user Bearer session. POST /api/transfers additionally requires admin and creates a durable row, then dispatches to source Agent.
source_findings.relay_auth_order: Gateway routes /agent/transfers/* to FileTransferManager before websocket routing. Agent relay ignores user Bearer auth: it first requires X-NodeSteer-Agent-ID and X-NodeSteer-Agent-Token, then resolves AgentID and authenticates the credential, then checks action/method, then Transfer relation.
source_findings.upload_relation: After Agent authentication, POST upload loads Transfer and checks SourceNodeID before canceled/idempotent state, upload headers/body, part-file creation, or mutation. A valid non-source Agent therefore gets 403 without changing Transfer or relay files.
source_findings.download_relation: After Agent authentication, GET download loads Transfer and requires staged SHA before checking target membership. A staged Transfer requested by an Agent absent from non-canceled Targets gets 403 before opening blob; a non-staged Transfer would return 404 first.
source_findings.positive_flow: Create dispatches upload to SourceNode; verified upload stores byte size/SHA and dispatches GET download to Targets. Agent atomically replaces destination and verifies expected size/SHA; delivery result advances Transfer/Target to SUCCESS. Success cleanup removes Hub part/blob. Store exposes no DeleteFileTransfer operation; API has no DELETE transfer route.
